user.title: Add a Smart Timer
user.description:
Create a new Smart Timer device. You can create as many as you like.
The default duration is what RESET returns to. Use 0 for a kitchen timer that starts empty.

data_description.name: A friendly name used for the device and entity, e.g. “Kitchen”.
data_description.initial_seconds: Seconds. 0 is allowed. Maximum is {max}. Reset always returns to this value.

abort.already_configured: A Smart Timer with that name already exists.

init.title: Smart Timer
init.description:
Default duration is used by RESET, including 0.

Sound is optional. The bundled kitchen timer sound plays on the selected media player unless you pick a custom file or no sound.

kitchen timer.wav by KeyKrusher — https://freesound.org/s/154954/ — License: Attribution 4.0

data_description.default_seconds: RESET returns to this value. 0 is allowed.
data_description.sound_source: Bundled kitchen timer, your own file, or no sound.
data_description.media_player: Required only if you want a sound to play.
data_description.sound_url: Used when Sound is set to custom.
data_description.sound_path: Local path, used when Sound is set to custom and no URL is set.
